name: La Tania
description: La Tania was built as the athletes' village for the 1992 Albertville Winter Olympics. Compact and car-free, set in a forest clearing at 1,400m. Direct access to both Courchevel and Méribel sectors of the 600km 3V domain. Home to Le Farçon (★ Michelin since 2006, Chef Julien Machet, 9-course tasting menu €180pp, seasonal Savoyard produce) and Bistrot Machet. Free shuttle to Aquamotion (Courchevel — indoor/outdoor pools, slides, spa, climbing wall, indoor surfing, gym). Quiet evening atmosphere — apres limited to a few bars.

overview.atmosphere: Compact family resort built for the 1992 Albertville Olympics. Wooded setting between Courchevel and Méribel. Le Farçon ★ Michelin. Quiet, family-friendly.

beyond_skiing.ice_skating: Olympic-sized rink at Courchevel 1850 Forum. Disco night Wednesdays 8-10pm.
beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Cinema, swimming pool at Hotel Le Montana, gym, Chez Nounours kindergarten (from 4 months)
